By 1289: 'By 1289, all of Quhistan had been conquered by the Mihrabanids.'

ledger.x: 1537: 'Mihrabanids became vassals of Safavids until 1537' and the Safavids took full control; infobox 'Disestablished: 1537'; the last malik was 'handing over control of Sistan'.

wars.outcome: The Timurid overlordship 'was ended in 1507 due to Uzbek invasion'; 'Uzbeks were driven in 1510 and Mihrabanids became vassals of Safavids until 1537' (Sistan page).
